notes.title: New Update! 06/06/2016
notes.notes:
We've changed some things around and made them better! The new update has gamepad support.

Bug Fixes
- Sometimes get stuck in wall after spawning
- Machine gun/Flamer sound effects bugs when entering shop
- Lava enemies getting stuck in lava pits
- VSync load on start up
- Rocket/bullets getting stuck in wall
- Gamepad support

Thank you guys, be sure to email me at coding4simple@gmail.com for any new updates and/or bugs you've found.
